mostWorthwhile.text: Tracing the refusal from the dispatch fields through the published policy and capacity log was most worthwhile: each record added a different part of the explanation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the rails and then separately securing the mount was a little repetitive, although the distinction made physical sense.

surprise.text: The van was empty because its availability had been sold, not because it was necessarily free to take the clinic order.

arbitrary.text: My attempt to compare the dispatch export directly with the policy did not work; the required comparison with the clinic dispatch became clear only from the compatibility feedback.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see whether the neighbors can challenge the commercial rule or build a more reliable alternative, though the straightforward repair steps were less engaging than the investigation.
